summary: Spoolman is a self-hosted filament & spool inventory manager for 3D printing (FastAPI + SQLAlchemy/Alembic; no auth by design, guarded by origin/host middleware). Persists vendors, filament types, spools, user settings, per-entity custom extra-field values and NFC/RFID tag->spool links; exposes CRUD, tag scan, backup and export endpoints.
